issue: Implies all villas are overwater; official also lists Beach Villas and island Signature Villas
detail: Description, highlights and body now say the overwater villas have retractable roofs/slides and that Beach Villas and Signature Villas are also on the island; added a 'not every villa is overwater' sentence in all 6 languages.

issue: Superlative: 'most architecturally playful overwater resort in the Indian Ocean'
detail: Removed the sentence from the description in all 6 languages.

issue: Observatory/largest telescopes, reef wine cave and two-hour seaplane not checked on the pages read
detail: No observatory/telescope or seaplane/flight-time statement found on the official pages (villas, dining, experiences). Removed the observatory highlight, 'Cinema and observatory' (now 'Outdoor cinema'), the observatory paragraph, the two-hour seaplane and 'least visited waters' wording and the observatory in meta descriptions. 'Reef wine cave' reworded to 'wine cellar' (official dining page lists a Wine Cellar).

issue: Does not give the number of overwater villas; official total is 24 villas across several types
detail: Added that Song Saa has 24 villas in total across several types (jungle, ocean view, overwater, others); official page does not give an overwater-only count, so none was added.

issue: Founders securing reef protection, 35 km distance and primary-forest claims not confirmed on pages read
detail: Founder claim reworded to what the official About page says (founder worked with local communities on Cambodia's first marine-protected area); '35 km from Sihanoukville' deleted from body and the Sihanoukville '35 km by boat' nearbyAttractions entry removed in all languages; 'primary tropical forest' replaced by 'native vegetation/scrub along the shoreline' (official: jungle villas nestled in native scrub along the shoreline).

issue: Official source does not state stilt construction, only 'Overwater Villas'
detail: English page never claims stilts (says Overwater Villas above the sea). Only the French metaTitle said 'villas sur pilotis'; changed to 'Overwater Villas'.

issue: Says 17 water bungalows; official lists 17 Water Bungalows plus 20 Superior Water Bungalows (37 overwater) and 50 beach bungalows
detail: Description, first highlight, intro paragraph and meta descriptions now give 37 water bungalows (17 Water + 20 Superior) and 50 Standard Deluxe beach bungalows, in all 6 languages.

issue: Treats three separate resorts (Desert Islands, Al Sahel, Al Yamm) as one 'Safari Resort'; no such official name
detail: Description, body and meta now describe three separate Anantara hotels (Desert Islands Resort & Spa, Al Sahel Villa Resort, Al Yamm Villa Resort, all Minor Hotels) and tell readers to confirm which one they book. The name field was not touched.

issue: 'Three options: beach villas, desert lodges, palace-style' does not match the official three-resort structure
detail: Replaced with the three-resort structure and room counts (64 rooms opened 2008; 30 villas each opened 2013) from Wikipedia.

issue: '250 km west of Abu Dhabi', '10,000 animals', 'first captive-born Arabian cheetah' and 'most unusual safari in the Middle East' are unsupported
detail: 250 km west corrected to about 170 km southwest (Wikipedia); '10,000 animals' replaced by 'thousands of free-roaming animals' (Wikipedia gives conflicting counts; the 10,000 figure now only appears as animals released into other reserves, as Wikipedia states); first captive-born cheetah and 'most unusual safari' deleted; also dropped acacia woodland, open 4WD, 170 bird species (Wikipedia: more than 100) and the unsupported mangrove superlative.

issue: Al Sahel and Al Yamm were reported as under refurbishment in 2025; current status unconfirmed
detail: Could not verify the refurbishment (Anantara pages return 403). Added a neutral line telling readers to check each hotel's current opening status and availability; no refurbishment claim was made.

issue: Names an 'Ocean Lodge' as one of six camps; official lists Mountain, Forest, Rock, Vlei, Zuka and Homestead and no Ocean Lodge
detail: Removed every Ocean Lodge reference (highlight, amenity, pro, seasonal notes, body); body now lists the six real lodges and describes bush-and-beach as nearby Indian Ocean activities; turtle nesting reworded to Sodwana Bay, four months of the southern summer.

issue: Describes Rock Lodge as on a bouldered hillside; official calls it a cliffside location
detail: Now a cliff-top pueblo suspended over the valley (brochure).

issue: 1990 acquisition and 'only sand forest in Africa' claims not checked against official pages
detail: Brochure: &Beyond was launched with Phinda in 1991 (first private game reserve in KwaZulu-Natal; original 13,076 ha, now 29,866 ha); body rewritten accordingly (also dropped the unsupported 'late 1980s' and fences-out narrative). 'Only sand forest in Africa' replaced by 'rare sand forest' home to suni and red duiker (brochure).

issue: 'All rooms have private balconies' not confirmed on the official pages read
detail: The cited official page https://barahi.com/chitwan-suites-rooms/ states 'All rooms have private balconies'.

issue: Lodge is outside the park boundary (safari starts across the river); page says 'near' correctly
detail: Page already says 'near/close to Chitwan National Park'; no claim of being inside the park.

issue: Operator is Wilderness per official site, not andBeyond (page and meta description say andBeyond)
detail: Replaced andBeyond with Wilderness in description, meta description and body in all 6 languages; also removed 'andBeyond's most architecturally striking property' and 'most theatrical' superlatives.

issue: Official site says the lodge is on the edge of / walking distance from Volcanoes National Park, not inside it
detail: Now 'at the foot of the Virunga volcanoes, within walking distance of Volcanoes National Park' (also dropped 'extinct volcano', 'most biodiverse park' claims from the description).

issue: Gorilla permit price and travel-time figures not checked against the source
detail: USD 1,500 permit confirmed. '10 minutes from the main gate' deleted (official: walking distance); Kigali '2.5 h by road / 30 min charter' replaced by official 'approximately 3-hour drive via Musanze, vehicle transfers, helicopter transfers offered'.

issue: Land area: andBeyond says 283,000 acres, operator site says 400,000 acres
detail: Used the cited operator page (maasai.com): 400,000 acres of Maasai-owned land, in description, highlight, meta and translations (the French hectare figure was converted accordingly). The andBeyond page was unreachable (404).

issue: 'Eight tented rooms' fits 6 cottages + 2 suites; 'Amboseli ecosystem' framing and 'dining tent' not confirmed
detail: Eight tented rooms confirmed (2 king + 4 twin cottages + 2 suites) and kept. Deleted the 'Amboseli ecosystem as it was designed to be seen' sentence and replaced 'dining tent' with 'camp'.

issue: Camp's own domain campiyakanzi.com now only shows webcams; county and nearest town not stated by the cited source
detail: County is only in the protected destination field ('Kajiado County') and location.region; the cited source does not state county or nearest town and the body text makes no county claim, so nothing editable was changed.

issue: Operator is now the independent Jao Reserve / Jao Collection, not Wilderness Safaris
detail: Removed Wilderness Safaris from description and meta; camp described as one of the Jao Reserve camps.

issue: 'Treehouse-style architecture' not supported: official says modern architectural camp
detail: Treehouse wording removed everywhere; now modern architecture tucked into island forest, five suites and two villas each with private plunge pool.

issue: Concession size given as 60,000 acres; third-party sources say 60,000 hectares
detail: Official page gives no concession size, so all 60,000-acre/hectare claims were removed (description, highlight, body) in all languages. Birding figure corrected to over 450 species in the Okavango Delta (official).

issue: Superlatives ('finest concession', 'most singular') unsupported
detail: Removed 'one of the continent's most singular lodges', 'extraordinary' concession and 'among the most beautiful architecture in Africa' wording.

issue: Page says Varty Camp established in the 1970s; official site says Londolozi began in 1926 and Varty Camp is nearly 100 years old
detail: Description, highlight, intro paragraph and 'evolved from its 1970s origins' now use 1926 (Varty Camp is the original camp; 10 chalets). One 1970s mention about the 'Female of Sparta' leopard in the leopards paragraph was left as it is a separate unsourced claim.

issue: 'Birthplace of the modern luxury safari', 'most reliable leopard sightings in Africa', 'World's Best Leopard Sightings' are unsupported superlatives
detail: Removed 'pioneer of the modern luxury safari', 'every luxury safari operation owes something to Londolozi', 'renowned' and 'reliable leopard sightings' wording (description, highlights, pros, meta, intro paragraph); replaced with the official 'Leopards of Londolozi are a much-loved experience'.

issue: Official site says Sabi Sand lies within the Greater Kruger; 'unfenced border with Kruger' not confirmed on cited pages
detail: Replaced unfenced-border claims (description, highlight, nearbyAttractions, meta) with 'Sabi Sand Game Reserve, part of the Greater Kruger'.

issue: Official name is 'Luxury Bush Camp' (one of five accommodation options); page calls it 'traditional safari camp'
detail: Replaced 'traditional safari camp' with Luxury Bush Camp (one of five options; eight thatched chalets and a Junior Suite) in description, highlight, body and meta descriptions. The name field was not touched.

issue: Bush camp page itself says '2,000ha' reserve while the main site says 22,000 hectares (source inconsistency)
detail: Official main site and 'at a glance' table state 22,000 hectares / 220 km2 consistently with the page; the 2,000ha on the bush camp page is an inconsistency in that source, so 22,000 was kept.

issue: Operator is Asilia Africa, not Governors' Camp group
detail: Governors' Camp replaced by Asilia Africa in description (6 languages).

issue: Page says ten tents; official says nine (including 2 family suites)
detail: Ten tents changed to nine safari tents in the body of all languages.

issue: 'Grove of fig trees' not confirmed; official says nestled among the trees
detail: Fig-tree wording replaced by 'among the trees' in description and body (all languages).

issue: Camp is closed April to May; page implies year-round
detail: Added 'closed in April and May, open June to March' to seasonalInfo notes in all languages.

issue: Nearest-town transfer (Mtito Andei, Madaraka Express) not confirmed on the pages read
detail: Official contact page says the Madaraka Express goes daily to Mtito Andei and guests are picked up on prior request; page text is correct.

issue: Official rooms also include self-catering bandas about 1.5 km from the main camp
detail: Added a sentence on the self-catering Kitani Bandas about 1.5 km from the main camp (vehicle needed) to the tents section in all languages.

issue: Page says only Sabora, Sasakwa and Faru Faru operate there; official lists seven (also Milele, Serengeti House, Explore, Kilima)
detail: Now lists all seven (Sasakwa, Faru Faru, Sabora, Milele, Kilima, Serengeti House, Explore); removed 'only camps operating' and 'three lodges and a tented camp'.

issue: Page treats the whole reserve as one hotel; it is a collection of separate lodges
detail: Description, highlights, pros and body now describe a collection of seven separate lodges and camps on the Grumeti Reserve managed with the Grumeti Fund (reserve created 1994, Fund managing since 2002, per official page); conservation paragraph limited to what the page states (incl. 2019 reintroduction of nine Eastern black rhino).

issue: 'Africa's finest safari service' and 'only vehicle present' are unsupported superlatives
detail: Removed from description, meta, highlight, pros and body ('only vehicle' passage, 'three decades', 'highest expression', 'one of Africa's most serious safari operations', 'most complete itinerary').

issue: Page says fifteen suites; official says 13 suites (plus a separate villa)
detail: Fifteen changed to thirteen glass-walled suites everywhere (description, highlight, pros, body, meta) in all languages; 'cantilevered over a gorge' changed to the official cliffside above the N'wanetsi River with decks and daybeds.

issue: 15,000-hectare concession figure not confirmed (other sources: about 13,500 ha)
detail: Official page gives no concession size; the hectare figure was removed from the body in all languages.

issue: Province given as Limpopo; not confirmed from a source
detail: The province appears only in the protected destination field ('Kruger National Park, Limpopo, South Africa'); the body does not state a province. Wikipedia says Kruger spans Limpopo and Mpumalanga, so the field is only partly accurate but could not be edited.

issue: 'The finest address in South African safari' is an unsupported superlative
detail: Removed from meta description (all languages) and from the 'finest private concession' bestFor line, and 'some of South Africa's finest safari guiding' from the description.
